_comment: DOCUMENT TYPES v1.1. Identical in every brand kit. The page geometry, the parts in order, the type step and the content budget for each slot, as data. reference/layout.md states the same values in prose and tables, and the two agree exactly. Brand-neutral: a color is a token name from tokens.json and snippets/palette.css, never a hex. A type step is a token from snippets/type-tokens.json. v1.1 adds the working-doc and sheet types, the editing rules and the Google conversion rules. types.generic is an alias of types.working-doc.

units.screen: px at 96 per inch. px = pt x 4/3

startHere: Is there an existing file? Follow the editing rules. Do not restyle it.
Did they point at a document to imitate? Copy it.
Otherwise pick a type. The first rule that fits wins.
Keep it short. Follow the wording budget.

rules.when: Rows and columns people will sort, filter or fill in, in Google Sheets or Excel. Words: tracker, list, log, roster, budget, workbook, spreadsheet.
Anything presented on a screen, in Google Slides or PowerPoint. One slide and a graphic for a slide count. Words: deck, slides, slide, presentation, pitch.

The default. Anything in Google Docs or Word that people will keep editing. Words: agenda, meeting guide, prep packet, status report, plan, charter, brief, notes, job description, scorecard, policy draft, proposal draft.
A designed single page for an outside reader, delivered as a PDF. Words: one-pager, fact sheet, flyer, leave-behind, case study, handout.
A designed document of three pages or more for an outside reader, delivered as a PDF. Words: report, proposal, review, analysis, white paper.
Only when the request asks for a memo by name.

choose.band: The band is for PDF, print and slides. A document that will live in Google Docs is a working-doc unless the person asks for a designed one-pager.
choose.existingFile: Follow the editing rules in editing. Keep the layout, the styles and the wording of the file. Change only what was asked.
choose.spreadsheet: A spreadsheet is the sheet type. types.sheet.

editing.name: Edit in place
editing.rule: Asked to edit, update, fix or add to an existing file: keep its layout, styles, fonts, sizes, colors, column order and wording. Change only what was asked. Same file, same link. Do not convert its format, move it or make a copy unless asked.

editing.name: Match the neighbors
editing.rule: New content inside an existing file takes the style of the nearest existing content of the same kind. A new row looks like the rows around it. A new slide uses the deck's own layout.

editing.name: A named example is the template
editing.rule: Asked to make it look like another document: that document is the template. Copy its structure, styles and order. The kit does not override it.

editing.name: Restyle only when asked
editing.rule: Restyle only on a request such as brand this, clean up the formatting or make it consistent. Then apply the working-doc styles to what is there: font, sizes, heading colors, table style, logo, footer. Do not reorder, rewrite or shorten the words. Do not add a band. Where the file has a band, take it out: the logo goes top left and the band's words go only if they are not already the title.

editing.name: An accepted format is fixed
editing.rule: A format a person has accepted, such as a recurring report or an agenda they approved, is reused exactly next time. Never improve it unprompted.

editing.name: Leave the words alone
editing.rule: Shorten or rewrite words only when asked. Asked to tighten: cut at least half and keep every fact, name, number and date.

editing.name: Delete nothing that is not yours
editing.rule: Never delete someone else's content, comments, formulas, data validation or tabs. Before a large change, say what will change. After, list what changed in three bullets or fewer.

editing.name: Never resize to fit
editing.rule: Never change the spacing, sizes or margins of an existing file to make an edit fit a page. If an edit pushes content onto a new page, leave it there and say so in the hand-back.

wording._comment: The wording budget. It applies to every type.
wording.firstLine: The first line states the decision, the ask or the status. In an agenda it states what the meeting is for.
never: A paragraph that restates the title
A sentence about the document itself
wording.preferTable: Items that share the same fields go in a table, not a paragraph.
wording.preferBullets: Parallel items go in bullets, not a paragraph.
wording.length: An agenda and a status report fit one page. Every other working-doc is as short as the content allows.

band.where: Top of page 1, edge to edge. No band on later pages

rule.note: A brand with no band rule fills the same 0.03in with --bg-band

title.align: left, on the left margin, centered vertically

logo.align: right, on the right margin, centered vertically

band.appliesTo: Memo, one-pager and report. PDF and print. A working-doc has no band

rule.position: above the first row and under every row

table.numberAlign: right, tabular lining figures. The header of a number column is right-aligned too

status.mark: HTML and PDF: a drawn square, 6pt in a document and 9pt on a slide. Word, PowerPoint and Google files: the character U+25A0, which Montserrat contains, followed by one no-break space. The mark and the word take the same alert text color
status.note: The word carries the meaning. Green means good only. A brand color is never a status color
status.office: U+25A0, in the alert text color, at 9pt in a document and 12pt on a slide, followed by one no-break space. In a working-doc the mark is set at the size of the word
status.neutral: A status that is neither good, caution nor bad takes --alert-info-text

table.columns: Column widths follow the content and sum to the text block. The first column is the widest. A status column is 1.2in in a document and 1.9in on a slide. Fixed layout, autofit off

rule.position: above every row and under the last

sign-off.where: Memo only. 24pt under the last block

footer.where: Bottom of every page, inside the margins. The last line sits on the bottom margin

rule.position: top edge, the width of the text block

footer.left: The signature: the brand name, a middle dot, then Internal when every reader is staff. Otherwise the document title, 40 characters at most
footer.withLockup: The lockup takes the left, on page 1 only. The signature and the page number share the right, joined by a middle dot
footer.workingDoc: A working-doc footer is one left-aligned line with no rule. types.working-doc.footer

lockup.appliesTo: brandFacts.<brand>.lockup. Operating companies only, on a memo, a one-pager, a report and a deck. Never on a working-doc or a sheet. Never on a Collective Edge document

logo.role: horizontal-on-light on white, horizontal-on-dark on a dark slide
logo.note: The minimum width of the Collective Edge horizontal logo. Never larger in a document

lockup.layout: One line. The words, then the logo to their right, centered on the line. No rule of its own

sheet.name: sheet
sheet.purpose: A tracker, list or workbook in Google Sheets or Excel

never: a tab that was not asked for, such as a cover tab or a How to use tab
layout.whyNoLogo: A growing table has no stable place for one

font.note: 10pt is the one size outside the house scale. Google Sheets sets whole point sizes only, so never 10.5pt. Bold off or bold on. Never name a weight family such as Montserrat SemiBold in a sheet: it falls back to Times New Roman

header.freezeFirstColumn: When it is the name or ID of the row

formats.moneyNote: Two decimals only when cents matter

status.control: A dropdown: data validation from a fixed list. No free text
status.value: U+25A0, a space, then the word
status.color: Set by conditional formatting on the value, never a hand fill
status.note: Use the default set when the request names no statuses. Fill and text come from alert in tokens.json

sheet.dueDate: Conditional formatting turns a date in the past --alert-stop-text, unless the status of the row is Done

notes.overflow: Longer context goes in a linked doc

tabNames.dates: No date unless the tab is a period

editing: Never overwrite a formula with a value.
Keep validations, conditional formats, frozen panes and column widths.
New columns go at the right. New rows go at the bottom or where the sort order puts them.
A sheet that already has its own colors and layout keeps them.
rules: One table per tab, starting at A1.
No logo and no lockup on a sheet.
A status is a dropdown of one or two words, never free text.
sheet.lockupPlacement: None. A sheet carries no logo and no Powered by Collective Edge

deck.name: deck
deck.purpose: Slides for a screen. One slide and a graphic for a slide count

textBlock.columns: 1 or 2. Two columns are 5.5in each with a 0.67in gap

bandRule.note: Dark slides only. A brand with no band rule draws nothing

slots.name: headline
slots.role: The one message of the slide, as a sentence

slots.name: body
slots.role: Paragraphs and bullets

slots.name: key-point
slots.role: A short statement between hairlines

slots.name: table-text
slots.role: Table cells. Header cells take weight 600

slots.name: caption
slots.role: Line above a table or chart, and the source line

slots.name: footer
slots.role: Page number, and the meta row on dark slides

logo.position: left, x 0.83in, centered on the footer row

pageNumber.content: The slide position in the deck as a bare numeral. The title slide is 1 and shows no number

footer.appliesTo: Every white slide. Dark slides carry no footer logo

rule.position: above every point and under the last

rules: One message per slide. The headline states it as a sentence.
Body text is 15pt. Nothing on a slide is under 12pt.
Content slides are white. Only title, divider and closing are dark.
Dark slides are a flat fill. No picture background.
Uppercase is for the title slide title only. Four words at most.
A headline that takes one line still reserves two. The body zone starts at y 2.53in on every white slide.
One chart or one table per slide.
No logo on a dark slide except title and closing.
A chart of one quantity is one series, in series color 1. Two series only when comparing two things.
No stat card and no big-number panel.

slots.name: logo
slots.role: horizontal-on-dark

slots.name: rule
slots.content: Above the meta row

slots.name: meta-left
slots.content: Brand or presenter

slots.name: meta-right
slots.content: Date

slots.name: number
slots.content: Two digits, tabular figures

slots.name: rule
slots.content: Above the meta row

slots.name: meta-left
slots.content: Brand name

slots.name: support
slots.content: Optional

layouts.name: text
layouts.purpose: A headline and one column of text

slots.name: body
slots.content: Up to five bullets of 80 characters, or up to three paragraphs of 420 characters in all

layouts.name: two-column
layouts.purpose: Key points beside one table, image or block of text

slots.name: key-points
slots.content: Each point sits between 0.75pt --border-1 rules with 12pt above and under the text

slots.name: right
slots.content: One table of four rows by three columns at most, or three bullets, or one image. A caption may sit above it

slots.name: chart
slots.content: One chart. Colors from reference/data-color.md. Caption above, source line under, both in the caption slot. One quantity is one series, in series color 1. Two series only when comparing two things. A bar chart holds four categories

slots.name: notes
slots.content: Optional. Without notes the chart takes the full 11.67in

slots.name: table
slots.content: Five body rows at 15pt. Six at the 12pt floor. Cell padding 9pt top and bottom, 12pt left and right

layouts.name: comparison
layouts.purpose: Two options or two states side by side

slots.name: left
slots.content: A label in the key-point slot, 24 characters at most, over a 1.5pt --fg-accent rule, then up to four bullets

slots.name: right
slots.content: The same as the left column

layouts.name: timeline
layouts.purpose: Three to five dated steps in a row

slots.name: steps
slots.content: Equal columns, 0.33in apart. Each step: a 1.5pt --fg-accent rule, the date at 15pt weight 600 in --fg-accent and 14 characters at most, a title in the key-point slot and 24 characters at most, a description at 15pt and 60 characters at most

slots.name: quote
slots.content: Curly quotation marks

slots.name: attribution
slots.content: Name at weight 700 in --fg-1, a comma, then the role

slots.name: takeaways
slots.content: One row each between 0.75pt --border-1 rules. The number sits in a 0.5in column at weight 600 in --fg-accent

slots.name: logo
slots.role: horizontal-on-dark

slots.name: lockup
slots.content: Operating companies only. A 0.75pt --border-on-dark rule at y 6.55in, 11.67in wide. On the footer row at y 6.73in, 0.35in tall: the words Powered by in --fg-on-dark-3, 12pt, weight 400, in a box at x 0.83in, 1.1in wide, anchored middle. Then the Collective Edge horizontal-on-dark logo at x 2.0in, y 6.80in, 1.25in wide, 0.208in tall. The date sits at right in 12pt --fg-on-dark-3. The lockup takes the place of the brand name. A Collective Edge deck carries the title slide meta row here instead

deck.lockupPlacement: Closing slide, in the footer row, at left. Nowhere else in the deck
deck.editing: Editing an existing deck, often one slide: use that deck's own layouts, fonts, colors and positions, even where they are not the kit's. Combine, split or reword slides without restyling the rest. Deliver the change inside the same deck. Combine these two slides means one slide that carries the content of both in the layout of the first, then delete the second. If the two say the same thing, say so and ask before deleting one.

graphic.what: A graphic to paste on a slide
graphic.note: The same type rules as a slide. 48px in the image is 24pt on the slide. No text under it but the co-brand line.
graphic.cobrand: Operating companies only. One line of words, Powered by Collective Edge, bottom right, 24px, weight 400, --fg-3. No logo

working-doc.name: working-doc
working-doc.purpose: The default. Anything people will keep editing in Google Docs or Word. Plain on purpose, so it survives conversion to Google Docs untouched

pages.note: An agenda and a status report fit 1 page. Anything else is as short as the content allows. Budget to 90 percent of a page in a Google file

working-doc.weightsNote: Bold off and bold on. Montserrat SemiBold is not needed

logo.position: Once, top left of page 1, inline, as its own paragraph

slots.name: title
slots.role: Names the document. Sentence case, no period

slots.name: meta-line
slots.role: Directly under the title. Owner or team, date as 13 November 2026, then audience or status if needed, separated by a middle dot with a space each side

slots.name: heading-1
slots.role: A plain label. Sentence case, no colon, no period

slots.name: heading-2
slots.role: A plain label. Sentence case, no colon, no period. Two heading levels at most

slots.name: body
slots.role: Running text. Flush left, never justified

slots.name: bullet

slots.name: table-header
slots.role: Header row of a table

slots.name: table-text
slots.role: Table cells. Numbers right-aligned

slots.name: status
slots.role: U+25A0, a no-break space, then the word, in one run. One or two words

slots.name: footer
slots.role: The document footer on every page. One left-aligned line. brandFacts.<brand>.workingDocFooter, with N as the page number field. No rule, no logo, no table

table.leftEdge: On the left margin. The cell padding sits inside the table and never pushes its edge outside the text block
table.betweenTables: One empty paragraph between two adjacent tables
table.note: The dark header fill is for the one-pager, the report and the deck only

patterns.agenda: A 3-column table: Time or minutes, Topic, Owner. Or a numbered list with the owner and the minutes at the end of each line. Never both.
patterns.statusReport: One line of overall status. Then a table: Item, Owner, Due, Status. Then bullets under the heading Needs a decision, if any.

working-doc.cobrand: None, as words or as a lockup
rules: No band. The band is for PDF, print and slides.
Two heading levels at most. Headings are plain labels of 6 words at most.
Weights 400 and 700 only.
One table style. Light header fill, hairline under every row, no vertical rules, no zebra.
No Powered by Collective Edge, as words or as a lockup. The rule follows the type, not the file format: a working-doc exported to PDF stays as it is.
working-doc.lockupPlacement: None. A working-doc never carries Powered by Collective Edge, as words or as a lockup
googleDocs: Set the named styles Title, Heading 1, Heading 2 and Normal to the slot values and use them.
Line spacing is a multiple: line_spacing as a float with line_spacing_rule MULTIPLE. Never EXACTLY and never a point value.
Name Montserrat on every style and every run, in w:ascii, w:hAnsi, w:eastAsia and w:cs.
Weight 700 is bold on. Do not name Montserrat SemiBold.
Table indent 6pt, the left cell padding. Fixed column widths that sum to 6.92in. One empty paragraph between two tables.
The logo is an inline picture. The footer is one plain paragraph with a PAGE field.
No text boxes, floating images, section breaks, columns or tab stops.

lockup._comment: The document lockup. Small on purpose: the Collective Edge logo at its minimum width, with the words at caption size, on one line. The 204px lockup in brands.json cobrand.lockup is for sites and dashboards only.
lockup.label: Powered by
lockup.layout: One line. The words, then the logo to their right, centered on the line. No rule of its own
lockup.minimum: 1.25in, 120px. The minimum width of the Collective Edge horizontal logo. Never larger in a document, never smaller anywhere

never: On a working-doc or a sheet
Inside or touching the operating company logo
Set as type where the logo fits. A chart or data graphic made on its own is the one place the words stand alone
Larger than the minimum width in a document, a deck or an image
cobrand.scope: Apex Paramedics and Royal Ambulance carry it once on everything delivered as a PDF, a deck or an image: memo, one-pager, report, proposal, deck, and a chart or data graphic made on its own. Small and quiet. A working-doc and a sheet never carry it. The rule follows the type, not the file format: a working-doc exported to PDF stays as it is. A Collective Edge document never carries it.
cobrand.exceptions: brands.json cobrand.doNot lists them: a clinical instruction and a patient-facing consent or safety document carry none

fitLadder.rule: Set the overflowing slot one step down the scale, to its floor and no further.
Cut the text to the limit of the slot.
Move the overflow to another page or slide. A one-pager cannot split.
Rebuild in the denser sibling type or layout.

fitNever: Never set type under its floor.
Never rely on auto-fit or shrink-on-overflow.
Never tighten leading or tracking to make text fit.

google._comment: What conversion to a Google file does, from a live test. The agent builds .docx with python-docx and .pptx with python-pptx, then uploads with conversion.

docs.fact: Exact line spacing in points lands about three times too far apart. Google Docs has proportional line spacing only.
docs.rule: Set line spacing as a multiple: 1.15 for headings, 1.35 for body. Never an exact point value.

docs.fact: A full-bleed band is impossible. A header table with a negative indent loses its cell padding.
docs.rule: A band is a table at text-block width with indent 0, and only on a designed document the person asked for. A working-doc has no band.
A left and right footer is a two-cell borderless table. A working-doc footer is one left-aligned line.

docs.fact: Two tables with nothing between them merge, and the second loses its column widths.
docs.rule: Put one empty paragraph between adjacent tables.

docs.fact: A table pokes about 9pt into the left margin.
docs.rule: Set the table indent to the left cell padding, 6pt, explicitly.

docs.fact: Line heights run taller than in Word, so a page that fits in Word can spill to two.
docs.rule: Budget to 90 percent of a page.

docs.fact: Montserrat SemiBold and Montserrat ExtraBold survive as real faces.
docs.rule: Name the family, bold off. A working-doc needs neither.

docs.fact: Text boxes, floating images, section breaks and columns do not convert cleanly.
docs.rule: Use none. Place the logo inline.

slides.rule: Set the size on every run.

slides.fact: A chart gains a visible value axis and loses thousands separators.
slides.rule: Delete the value axis. Switch data labels on and set their number format to #,##0.

slides.fact: A second series adds a legend and a second color the reader has to decode.
slides.rule: One quantity is one series, in series color 1. Two series only when comparing two things.

brandFacts._comment: The only facts that differ by brand, besides the color values behind each token. Logo files resolve by role from brands.json. Hex values resolve from each kit's tokens.json.
